name: flow-ai-video
description: Generate images and videos using your connected Flow AI Video account.

interface.longDescription:
AI Video Generator Flow lets you create images and videos with your connected Flow AI Video account. Describe a scene to generate a new image, upload your own image and describe the changes you want, turn a text brief into a video, or animate an uploaded image. Review supported models and settings, check your existing account credits, and retrieve the finished media in the conversation.

Generation uses your Flow account credits and entitlements. Available models, input limits, settings, completion times and output quality vary. Image edits are generative and may change details. This plugin does not purchase credits or change subscriptions.
capabilities: AI photo editing from uploaded images
Image to video from uploaded images
View available models and account credits
defaultPrompt: Create an image of a ceramic coffee cup in soft morning light.
Edit my uploaded product photo to use a clean studio background.
Animate my uploaded image into a short vertical video.

positive.description: Text-to-image. Use a dedicated account with sufficient credits; no uploaded reference required.
positive.prompt: Generate one square image of a ceramic cup on a wooden table in morning light.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve supported settings from live tools; state a credit cost only when the tool returns one. Submit one image using a stable request_id. Retrieve the same image job until completed and display only the returned result URL. Pending is not success.

positive.description: AI photo editor. Reviewer supplies a non-sensitive product photo via the implemented user-upload flow. The reviewer attaches one JPEG or PNG in ChatGPT; end-to-end import must be tested before submission.
positive.prompt: Edit my uploaded product photo to put it on a plain white studio background, keeping the product appearance.
positive.expected_behavior: Call import_image with the host-provided file object. Use the returned asset_id as reference_asset_id in generate_image. Submit one edit; return the resulting image. Do not silently generate from text alone or claim exact preservation of every detail.

positive.description: Text-to-video. Requires a dedicated account entitled to the selected video model and sufficient credits.
positive.prompt: Generate one five-second vertical video of gentle waves washing over a sandy beach.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a supported model with duration_seconds 5 and aspect_ratio 9:16. State a cost only if returned by live tools, submit once, then check the same video job. Deliver a playable returned URL only on completion.

positive.description: Image-to-video. Reviewer supplies a non-sensitive landscape or product photo via the implemented upload flow. The reviewer attaches one JPEG or PNG in ChatGPT; end-to-end import must be tested before submission.
positive.prompt: Animate my uploaded image into a five-second video with a gentle camera push-in.
positive.expected_behavior: Call import_image with the host-provided file object, pass its asset_id as reference_asset_id into generate_video with duration_seconds 5, and return that job’s completed video. Missing/unsupported upload should cause a clear explanation, not an unreferenced generation.

positive.description: Read-only discovery and account check; no generation or charge.
positive.prompt: What image and video options can I use, and how many Flow credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Return current supported settings and the connected account balance. Do not submit media, create extra assets, modify subscriptions, or show another account’s data.

negative.description: Text-only creative advice. Answer in text without invoking generation or upload tools.
negative.prompt: Write three captions for a coffee photo.

negative.description: Audio generation is outside this release. Explain the limitation; do not invoke image/video generation as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Generate a music track for my video.

negative.description: Purchasing and subscription changes are not supported. Explain that limitation without checkout, payment, or generation tool use.
negative.prompt: Buy more Flow credits and upgrade my subscription.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, checkout, credit sales, or subscription changes occur in this plugin. Existing Flow account credits and entitlements are used for generation.
prompts: Create an image of a ceramic coffee cup in soft morning light.

publication.release_notes: Initial integration for text-to-image, AI photo editing, text-to-video, and image-to-video, with account authorization, model discovery, and job status retrieval.
